name: Apt source
description: A third-party apt repository (a PPA or a vendor's): instances install from it only once it is approved, so the allow list starts empty

fields.name: Name
fields.description: A short name, used in its file names (letters, digits and dashes)

fields.name: Suites
fields.description: Its suites, space separated, e.g. noble

fields.name: Components
fields.description: Its components, space separated, e.g. main

fields.name: Approved
fields.description: On the allow list: only an approved source is written to an instance
